svg.title: Premise — the company brain that knows what your next pull request will break
svg.desc: Flagship project card. A pull request changes paylane.retry_window from 24h to 72h; the change propagates red through config, an assumption and four guarantees to ADR-012 and its owners, the merge is blocked, then a verified fix heals the graph. 275 nodes and 488 edges from 88 sources, 380 tests, red team 35 of 35 safe. Built for WeMakeDevs x FalkorDB Graph Hacks.
svg.text: The company brain that knows what
your next pull request will break.
Workers turn ADRs, config, tickets and runbooks into one
FalkorDB graph. On every PR an agent walks it, blocks the
merge, routes reviewers, and opens a fix only after the

g.text: CLEAR · FIX VERIFIED BY THE GRAPH
